title: Cloud Safeguard MVP: capability broker for AI agents
north_star: Agents get just-in-time least-privilege cloud capability leases instead of long-lived AK/SK, without losing speed or losing an audit trail.

plan.problem: AI agents operating real cloud resources currently rely on long-lived, broadly privileged AK/SK pairs: a leak is account takeover, rotation means hunting every copied key (agent config, ~/.aliyun/config.json, ~/.acme.sh/account.conf), cloud audit cannot attribute actions to an agent/task/approval, and per-task least privilege is too slow so operators fall back to admin.
plan.hypothesis: Put the broker AccessKey in an encrypted vault and expose capabilities instead of credentials: policy-evaluated, TTL-bounded, STS-scoped capability leases with auto-approval for low risk, one-click human approval for risky work and a tamper-evident audit chain. This keeps agent speed while enforcing least privilege and accountability.
plan.success_metric: Zero long-lived cloud credentials outside the vault; read-only lease to credential in <2s with no human; scoped write in <30s including approval; 100% of lease requests and cloud API calls attributable in the audit chain; all acceptance criteria A1-A16 pass on an independent verification of the committed candidate.
non_goals: credential-free cloud API proxy mode (roadmap P1)
cloud providers other than Alibaba Cloud
real cloud account calls during this build (mock mode is the verification path; sts mode unit-tested against a fake STS endpoint)
plan.final_demo: make build; ./scripts/demo.sh --port 18787 --data-dir <clean tmp> -> S1-S8 PASS (auto-approve + scoped read, least-privilege 403, approval, denial, ungranted denial, break-glass + live revoke, audit verify); embedded console E2E (login -> approve pending lease -> active + credential available) with screenshots; clean-clone go test ./..., go vet, npm typecheck/build.

design: Single Go binary control plane (SQLite + AES-256-GCM vault + policy engine + hash-chained audit + sweeper + embedded React console) with a csg CLI. Providers: Alibaba Cloud STS AssumeRole (in-tree RPC v1 signer) and a mock mode backed by an in-binary mock cloud that enforces the same IAM policy documents. Normative contract: docs/CONTRACT.md; product definition: docs/SPEC.md.

target.name: local macOS host; Go control plane + embedded web console + REST API + CLI; mock cloud demo (no real cloud creds)

criteria.expectation: csg init --demo creates 0700 data dir, 0600 master key/DB, admin token, 5 built-in capabilities, 1 mock provider, 2 demo agents; tokens shown once; re-init refused without --force.
make build produces bin/csg; serve exposes /healthz, /api/v1, embedded console at /, SPA fallback, graceful SIGINT shutdown.
Auto-approve flow: low-risk lease active, credential envelope returns ALIBABA_CLOUD_* STS token, mock cloud read succeeds.

Least privilege enforced: same credential denied 403 on out-of-policy action; TTL/agent/global limits, concurrency and rate limits deny with explicit reasons; sweeper expires leases and scrubs credentials.
Server-side enforcement: forged/expired/revoked mock tokens 401; admin vs agent token domains separated; agent cannot read another agent lease (404); suspended agent blocked.
Human approval and denial work from CLI and web console; leases become active/denied; audit trail records request/approval/denial/issuance.
Audit hash chain verifies on clean DB and fails after tampering (Go test + independent probe).
No plaintext broker secret, STS secret or agent token in DB/WAL, access logs, API responses, or JS bundle.
Vault AES-256-GCM with AAD binding; wrong AAD fails; provider credential never returned by API.
Policy settings editable and effective (raising auto-approve risk changes lease outcome), invalid settings rejected 400, change audited.
Provider credential rotation works, is audited, existing leases unaffected, new leases mint with new credential, no agent changes.
Agent token rotation invalidates old token; suspend blocks; per-agent limits enforced with explicit reasons.
Web console E2E: login, overview real counts, approve pending lease from UI, agent token shown once, audit verify works, no uncaught console errors; screenshots captured.
go test ./... and go vet ./... pass; web typecheck+build pass; formatting clean.
Demo S1-S8 reproducible from clean data dir, exit 0, no leftover server process.
README/QUICKSTART commands execute as documented; PRODUCT/SECURITY/ARCHITECTURE match shipped behavior and list limitations honestly.
